box-borders.label: Four OpenTUI box border styles: single, double, rounded, and heavy

text-attributes.label: Text attributes applied to bold, italic, and underlined content

box-title-alignment.label: Box with a centered top title and right-aligned bottom title

color-palette.label: OpenTUI's 256-color fallback palette: 16 terminal colors, six red-level slices of the RGB cube, and 24 grays. Blue increases rightward and green downward within each slice.

color-alpha.label: Green #22c55e over a gray checkerboard at alpha 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1. The checkerboard remains visible through translucent tiles and disappears at alpha 1.

layout-flex-columns.label: A 34-column container with a one-cell border and padding, an eight-column fixed child, a two-column gap, and a growing child filling the remaining 20 columns

layout-alignment.label: Three children distributed horizontally with space-between: one-row A and three-row B share a vertical center, while C overrides alignment to sit at the bottom

layout-cell-rounding.label: Three equal grow factors divide 30 inner columns into 10, 10, and 10 cells; adding one terminal column changes the allocation to 10, 11, and 10 cells

layout-wrap-wide.label: At 32 terminal columns, three eight-column children A, B, and C fit in one row with two-column gaps

layout-wrap-narrow.label: After resizing the same terminal to 22 columns, A and B stay on the first row while C wraps to a second row and the container grows taller

renderable-created.label: An 18-column shaded panel containing a status that says Waiting

renderable-mutated.label: After changing content and width, the same shaded panel is 30 columns wide and its retained status says Ready

renderable-reparent-before.label: Before reparenting, the shaded Message subtree is a child of first; second is empty

renderable-reparent-after.label: After second.add(message), the same shaded Message subtree is a child of second; first is empty

renderable-visibility.label: Visible: the panel contains Detail above Next. Hidden: Next moves up, but Detail stays attached and the panel still has two children. Detached: Next moves up, Detail has no parent, and the panel has one child. Neither operation destroys Detail.

text-styled-chunks.label: Styled chunks: Status is bold, Note is italic, and Next combines bold and underline

text-cell-ruler.label: Zero-based display columns: ASCII ABC occupies three cells; A界B occupies four, with 界 shaded across columns 1 and 2. Each marker follows the text immediately.

text-wide-wrap.label: Character wrapping of A界B at widths 2, 3, and 4: the two shaded cells occupied by 界 move intact to the next row when only one cell remains

text-line-offsets.label: Both three-column views select B: soft-wrapped A界B uses display offsets [3, 4), while A界 followed by a newline and B uses [4, 5)

interaction-hit-bubbling.label: The overlapping front box receives the hit, bubbles to its parent, then stops a second down event

interaction-drag-selection.label: A drag selects the app on the first line and Test on the second, with text-buffer offsets [6, 18)

input-placeholder.label: An unfocused name input displaying the placeholder Enter your name

input-focused.label: A focused name input containing Ada Lovelace with its cursor visible

textarea-wrap.label: A multiline textarea wrapping a long line at a word boundary

textarea-selection.label: A focused multiline textarea with keyboard focus selected

select-options.label: New file, Open file, and Save options with Open file selected

tab-select-tabs.label: Home, Files, and Settings tabs with Files selected and underlined

interaction-selection-focus.label: The word text is selected above a focused command input containing deploy --check

slider-horizontal.label: Horizontal slider with its thumb positioned at 25 out of 100

slider-vertical.label: Vertical slider with its thumb positioned at 0.5 out of 1

scrollbar-arrows.label: Standalone vertical scrollbar with arrows at position 0, showing 20 of 200 rows

scrollbox-top.label: ScrollBox at offset 0 showing index.ts, app.ts, layout.ts, theme.ts, and events.ts

scrollbox-scrolled.label: ScrollBox at offset 5 showing input.ts, scroll.ts, render.ts, state.ts, and config.ts

plugin-slot-modes.label: Plugin slots: append shows host, clock, and sync; replace shows clock and sync; single winner shows clock

keymap-active-keys.label: Active key bindings: Ctrl+S saves the file; Q quits the application

text-table-styled.label: Rounded table with Service, Status, and Notes columns: api OK, worker DEGRADED

line-number-editor.label: Three lines of numbered code with a sign beside serve(port)

code-highlighted.label: JavaScript function hello with bold keywords, a muted string, and an italic comment

markdown-table-grid.label: Bordered Markdown table with Name and Status columns: api ready, worker paused

markdown-table-columns.label: Borderless Markdown table with Name and Status columns: api ready, worker paused

diff-unified.label: Unified diff replacing const a = 1 with const a = 2

diff-split.label: Split diff replacing const a = 1 with const a = 2

ascii-font-tiny.label: OPEN drawn with OpenTUI's compact tiny ASCII font

ascii-font-block.label: OPEN drawn with OpenTUI's six-row block ASCII font

frame-buffer-draw.label: Network throughput chart showing receive at 42 MB/s and transmit at 18 MB/s

frame-buffer-progress.label: Package download progress at 70%, with 14 of 20 files complete

embedded-terminal-vt.label: Embedded terminal test run with two passed and zero failed

image-blocks.label: Generated RGBA landscape displayed with the Unicode block image protocol

qr-code-version-one.label: Scannable version-one QR code encoding OPENTUI with a four-module white quiet zone
